map.Morse跌倒评估量表，6个项目评估患者跌倒风险（0-125分），分值越高风险越: The Morse Fall Scale assesses fall risk with 6 items (0-125 points); the higher the score, the greater the risk. Selecting an option scores automatically.
map.入院 24h 内完成评估，≥45 分挂高危标识并床旁陪护。: Complete the assessment within 24h of admission; a score of 45 or above flags high risk and requires bedside accompaniment.

map.自动评分能替代人工吗？: Can automatic scoring replace manual assessment?
map.不能，仅提速，维度判定需护士床旁确认。: No, it only speeds things up; dimension judgment still needs bedside confirmation by a nurse.
map.临界 45 分如何管？: How to manage a borderline score of 45?
map.按高危管理并加强巡视，结合临床。: Manage as high risk with closer rounds, combined with clinical judgment.
map.评估频次？: How often should it be assessed?
map.至少入院、转科、病情变化时评估，高危者每周复评。: Assess at least on admission, on transfer and when the condition changes, weekly for high-risk patients.
